apt.description: APT configuration for mirrors, sources, and proxy.

apt.add_ppa_indeed.description: Deprecated; use apt.sources with proper source lines instead.

apt.preserve_sources_list.description: If true, don’t replace existing /etc/apt/sources.list. Useful when customizing existing images.

apt.primary.arches.description: List of architectures for which the primary repo applies. Use ['default'] to apply everywhere.

apt.primary.keyid.description: GPG key ID for verifying primary repo. Omit if using signed-by=.

apt.primary.keyserver.description: Keyserver used to fetch GPG keys for APT.

apt.primary.suite.description: Suite name (e.g., focal, jammy, noble) — used with primary URI.

apt.primary.uri.description: Base URI of the primary APT repository.

apt.proxy.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for APT operations.

apt.sources.description: List of additional APT sources (PPAs or custom repos).

apt.sources[].keyid.description: GPG key ID to verify this source.

apt.sources[].keyserver.description: Keyserver to retrieve the key from.

apt.sources[].name.description: Identifier for the APT source file (e.g., 'my-ppa').

apt.sources[].source.description: APT source line. May use $ARCH and $RELEASE substitutions.

bootcmd.description: List of shell commands to run at earliest boot stage (before cloud-init modules). Use with caution.

config_version.description: cloud-config version; must be 2 for modern configs.

disable_root.description: If true, disable the root account (lock it and prevent password login).

fqdn.description: Fully-qualified domain name. Must be set if hostnamed is to be used.

mounts.description: List of filesystem mount points to create and mount on boot.

mounts[].device.description: Block device or UUID to mount (e.g., /dev/disk/by-uuid/...).

mounts[].freq.description: Dump frequency (0 or 1) — used by dump(8).

network.description: Network configuration using netplan v2 schema (recommended).

network.config.interfaces[].accept_ra.description: If true, accept IPv6 router advertisements (RA).

network.config.interfaces[].addresses.description: List of static IPv4/IPv6 addresses with prefix (e.g., '10.0.0.5/24').

network.config.interfaces[].auto.description: If true, bring interface up at boot.

network.config.interfaces[].type.description: Interface type: ethernet, bond, vlan, bridge.

ntp.enabled.description: If true, configure and enable NTP (via chrony or systemd-timesyncd).

package_upgrade.description: If true, run apt-get upgrade on first boot.

packages.description: List of package names to install via apt.

power_state.message.description: Message written to syslog and console before power action.

power_state.mode.description: Power action: poweroff, reboot, halt, or suspend.

power_state.timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for waiting on services before powering off.

repo_update.description: Deprecated alias for package_upgrade: true. Prefer package_upgrade.

repo_upgrade.description: Deprecated alias for package_upgrade: true. Prefer package_upgrade.

resize_rootfs.description: If true, automatically resize root filesystem on first boot (if underlying disk is larger).

runcmd.description: List of shell commands to run at first boot (after network is up and users created).

ssh_authorized_keys.description: Global list of SSH public keys to add to all users’ authorized_keys unless overridden per-user.

ssh_deletekeys.description: If true, delete existing SSH host keys and regenerate them on first boot.

ssh_genkeytypes.description: List of SSH key types to generate for host keys.

ssh_putkeys.description: Deprecated: Map of key type to private key (e.g., rsa: '...'). Use write_files or ssh_authorized_keys instead.

ssh_pwauth.description: If true, enable password authentication for SSH.

system_info.description: Override system information (rarely needed; used in testing). Use only when building custom images. See cloud-init docs for limitations.

system_info.arch.description: Architecture name (e.g., amd64, arm64). Required only when overriding system_info.

system_info.dist.description: OS distribution name. Required only when overriding system_info.

system_info.release.description: OS distribution release codename. Required only when overriding system_info.

users[].groups.description: Supplementary groups for the user (e.g., adm, docker).

users[].lock_passwd.description: If true, lock password (disable password auth); requires SSH keys.

users[].ssh_authorized_keys.description: List of SSH public keys to add to authorized_keys for this user.

users[].sudo.description: Sudoers entry or boolean; if true, grants passwordless sudo.

v1_data.description: Raw cloud-config v1 data (deprecated). Use structured keys above instead.

write_files.description: List of files to write (including content, ownership, and permissions).

write_files[].append.description: If true, append to existing file instead of overwriting.

write_files[].path.description: Absolute path of the file to create.

write_files[].permissions.description: Octal permission bits for the file.
